description.main: Catalogue of Kerry James Marshall's 2014 exhibition of new paintings at David Zwirner London, with essay by Robert Storr and a conversation between the artist and Angela Choon.
description.extended:
The catalogue for Kerry James Marshall's 2014 exhibition at David Zwirner London, his first solo show in the city since 2005.

The show, at 24 Grafton Street from 11 October to 22 November 2014, presented new paintings. The book reproduces every painting in it, with detail enlargements, preparatory drawings and installation photographs. Robert Storr contributes new scholarship, and Angela Choon, a senior partner at the gallery, conducts a conversation with the artist. The hardcover was designed by JNL Design in Chicago and printed in Italy. It runs to 112 pages with 74 color reproductions.

Marshall paints real and imagined episodes from African-American history, often rendering figures in deep black. The London show ran alongside the touring survey Painting and Other Stuff, which was in Barcelona and Madrid through 26 October 2014.
